subject: math
description: Calculate and interpret interquartile range as the spread of the middle 50 percent of data.
learningObjectives: Order data and split it correctly to find quartiles.
Calculate interquartile range using IQR = Q3 - Q1.
Interpret IQR as the spread of the middle 50 percent of a data set.
Compare data sets using IQR and explain which middle half is more consistent.
Avoid confusing interquartile range with full range.
prerequisites: Order numbers from least to greatest
Find the median of a data set
Find Q1 and Q3 from ordered data
Write a short explanation using evidence
